description: This Java class 'ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory' creates JMS connections based on provided connection configurations. It handles URI construction, SSL configuration, failover support, and connection initialization for AMQP over JMS, acting as a factory for JMS connections using Qpid JMS library.

classes.name: ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory
classes.description: A thread-unsafe factory class that creates JMS connections based on a given Connection object and configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to obtain an instance of ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory with specific configuration.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a JMS connection based on the provided Connection object, attaching an exception listener and logging.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a JNDI initial context with environment setup for accessing the JMS connection factory.

methods.name: buildAmqpConnectionUriFromConnection
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP connection URI string based on connection parameters, security settings, and optional configurations including failover.

methods.name: isSecuredConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection uses the secure AMQP scheme (amqps).

methods.name: formatUri
methods.description: Formats a URI string given protocol, hostname, and port.

methods.name: getJmsParameters
methods.description: Generates a list of JMS-specific URI parameters based on connection details, including timeout and credentials.

methods.name: isPermittedJmsConfig
methods.description: Filters which configuration entries are allowed as JMS URI parameters.

methods.name: getAmqpParameters
methods.description: Generates AMQP protocol parameters, including SASL mechanisms based on whether the connection is anonymous.

methods.name: getTransportParameters
methods.description: Creates transport layer parameters, e.g., for trust and host verification in SSL connections.

methods.name: getFailoverParameters
methods.description: Adds failover-specific options to the URI, including reconnect attempts and delays.

methods.name: wrapWithFailOver
methods.description: Wraps the AMQP URI with a failover URI prefix to enable reconnect logic.
